scenarios.name: SE-1 TDD writes the test first and runs it red
scenarios.when: a haiku session is asked to use craftflow:test-driven-development to add is_even
scenarios.then: test file edited before calc.py, a test run between them, final pytest passes

scenarios.name: SE-2 Debugging reproduces before fixing
scenarios.given: a scratch project whose average() test fails
scenarios.when: a haiku session is asked to use craftflow:systematic-debugging
scenarios.then: a test run precedes the first edit of calc.py, final pytest passes

scenarios.name: SE-3 Review names the injection and edits nothing
scenarios.given: a scratch project with a diff that builds SQL with an f-string
scenarios.when: a haiku session is asked to use craftflow:code-review-patterns
scenarios.then: the result names the SQL injection; no Edit or Write call

scenarios.name: SE-4 Verification refuses a false completion
scenarios.given: a scratch project whose double() test fails and a note claiming it is done
scenarios.when: a haiku session is asked to use craftflow:verification-before-completion to confirm completion
scenarios.then: the tests are run; the result reports the failure and does not claim completion; no edits
